svg.title: Signature Doctor interface illustration — simulated demo data
svg.desc: A static illustration of Signature Doctor's charcoal and amber dashboard. The synthetic Asterion demo has nine recipes: four valid, one moved, one ambiguous, one missing, one validation failure, and one disabled. Five of eight enabled recipes pass. No results are approved. ViewMatrix is selected, showing its actual simulated resolution evidence. This is an interface illustration, not a browser screenshot or live-target result.
svg.text: Catch broken signatures. Review what moved. Ship with confidence.
Approval is scoped to this check.
